title: ID Selector
body:
Matches the one element with a given `id` attribute. Written with a leading `#`. ```html
ghi
``` ```css #first { background: green; } ``` An `id` is supposed to be unique in the document, so this selects a single element. That is why `document.querySelector("#first")` is the standard way to grab one specific node in [[Selecting Nodes]]. Contrast [[Class Selector]], which is reusable. See [[CSS Selectors]].
